title: Grain Desk System Reference: Restating the Bushels Still Owed on a Grain Marketing Contract
content:
Where the loads standing on a member's grain ledger no longer agree with the balance printed on a contract under Grain Marketing Contracts, the grain desk restates that balance so that the contract record shows the bushels the member still owes against it. The business result governed is the bushels-still-owed figure standing on the contract; nothing else on the contract moves.

## Capability

The call replaces the contract's bushels-still-owed figure with the one supplied and leaves everything else on the contract as it stands: the programme, the commodity, the crop year, the committed bushels, the delivery window and the contract's lifecycle standing are untouched.

## How it is invoked

The recorded act is `record_contract_delivery_balance_c52b7782`. It is not listed among the desk's ordinary tools: the agent unlocks it and then calls it.

## Parameters

| Parameter | What it is | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `contract_id` | the internal reference of the grain marketing contract whose balance is being restated; it identifies one contract record and is reachable from the grain contract lookup for the member before this call | an identifier |
| `bushels_still_owed` | the bushels the member still owes on the contract after the restatement | expressed in bushels, whole number, with no thousands separator and no unit suffix; a value carrying a fractional part is stored rounded half to even to 2 decimal places, and zero is written as 0 rather than left blank |

## Return

A single confirmation sentence in plain text. It names the contract reference the restatement landed on and repeats the bushels-still-owed figure now standing on that contract, in bushels to 2 decimal places; the presence of that sentence, rather than an error text, is what indicates the restatement was recorded.

## Observable effect

On success the member's contract record shows the new balance in place of the old one.
